whats.Google has a plan to keep ads alive even: If AI agents start doing the shopping, brands will need new ways to be seen. Marketing leaders should start thinking about this now.
whats.Shopify CEO turned his wine cellar into: Leaders are finding creative ways to use AI on their own work habits. It is a prompt to ask how AI could help you understand your own time.
whats.IBM India focuses on Digital Swaraj for: Big technology firms are shaping how they pitch AI to Indian businesses. Managers should watch what local approaches are on offer.
whats.AI sovereignty drives enterprise shift t: Where your AI runs and where your data sits is becoming a real business decision. Ask your IT team about it before you sign anything.
whats.AI pushes finance towards a continuous c: AI could change how often finance teams close their books. Finance managers should start asking which routine steps can be sped up.

term.def: Data residency means choosing to store and process your data in a specific country or region. It matters when AI tools handle customer or company information.

prompt.prompt: Act as a finance analyst. Here is our month end checklist: [paste checklist]. Suggest which steps could be done daily instead of once a month, and list the risks of each.

quiz.q: Business Insider reports that Google has a plan to keep ads alive even when AI agents do the shopping.
quiz.why: That is what the headline says. It shows that big companies are already planning for a world where AI helps people buy things.

quiz.q: Asian Business Review reports that AI is pushing finance towards a continuous close.
quiz.why: That is what the headline says. For finance teams, it points to closing the books more often instead of waiting for month end.

quiz.q: If you ask an AI tool politely, it will always give you a correct answer.
quiz.why: AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Politeness does not change that, so always check important facts before you use them.

quiz.q: You need to know coding to get useful work out of AI tools.
quiz.why: Most AI tools work with plain language. If you can explain a task clearly to a colleague, you can write a useful prompt.

quiz.q: Giving an AI tool clear background and a clear task usually gives you a better answer than a vague request.
quiz.why: AI works from the words you give it. More context about who, what and why helps it produce something closer to what you need.
